title: Qwen3Guard Technical Report
paper_type_zh: 安全护栏技术报告与开源模型发布
best_for_zh: 审计安全分类数据、护栏反馈与流式干预披露边界的读者
one_line: Qwen3Guard discloses a 1.19M-scale human/synthetic safety-classification mixture, Gen SFT and Stream token-label construction, and a separate safety-RL use case, while withholding record provenance, full label/reward calibration, and reproducible training artifacts.
Qwen3Guard 披露了约 119 万条人工/合成安全分类样本、Gen 的 SFT、Stream 的 token 级标签构造及一个独立的安全 RL 应用，但未公开记录级来源、完整标签/奖励校准或可复现训练工件。
why: It lets the atlas distinguish a released guard model and partly described safety-data/feedback pipeline from a reusable, fully audited filtering or RL-reward recipe.
inclusion_reason: Official Qwen report and releases disclose a safety-classification data object, Gen SFT and Stream token-label construction, model artifacts, and a bounded safety-RL use case. The same sources leave important data, verifier, and audit contracts undisclosed, making it a high-value Track 12 ledger entry.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open safety guards often classify only a completed response as safe or unsafe. The Qwen report frames two practical gaps: binary labels may not map cleanly to different deployment policies, and whole-response classification cannot intervene while an answer is streaming. For a reasoning-data atlas, the relevant question is not simply whether a guard scores well, but what prompts, responses, labels, and feedback procedures constitute the guard's trainable or deployable data object.

Qwen3Guard addresses this with a Gen variant that performs instruction-following moderation and a Stream variant that classifies generation incrementally. The report discloses meaningful construction interfaces, but it does not release the record-level training corpus, complete policy/label artifacts, or a reproducible feedback audit.

开放安全护栏通常只能在完整回复生成后，将其判为安全或不安全。Qwen 的报告指出两个实际缺口：二元标签未必能映射到不同部署场景的安全策略，而整段回复分类无法在流式生成时介入。对推理数据图谱而言，关键不只是护栏得分是否高，而是哪些提示、回复、标签和反馈过程构成了可训练或可部署的数据对象。

Qwen3Guard 以 Gen 变体进行指令遵循式审核，并以 Stream 变体进行增量分类。报告披露了有意义的构造接口，但未发布记录级训练语料、完整的策略/标签工件或可复现的反馈审计。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Qwen3Guard is a Qwen-family safety-moderation release with two distinct data/feedback interfaces. Qwen3Guard-Gen receives moderation instructions, a safety policy/category specification, dialogue context, and target content; it produces a risk assessment and category, plus a refusal judgment for model-response classification. Qwen3Guard-Stream adds query and response heads so that response tokens can be classified during generation.

The disclosed Gen corpus has more than 1.19M human-annotated and synthetic positive/negative prompt and response samples. Gen is trained with SFT, while Stream uses derived token labels and supervised classification losses. Separately, the report shows Gen used as a safety judge in a GSPO safety-RL experiment. That downstream reward demonstration is relevant to filtering/RL design, but is not the verified training contract for the guard models themselves.

Qwen3Guard 是 Qwen 系列的安全审核发布，包含两种不同的数据/反馈接口。Qwen3Guard-Gen 接收审核指令、安全策略/类别规范、对话上下文和目标内容；它输出风险判断与类别，并在模型回复分类时额外输出拒答判断。Qwen3Guard-Stream 增加 query 与 response 分类头，使回复 token 能在生成过程中被分类。

已披露的 Gen 语料包含超过 119 万条人工标注和合成的正/负提示与回复样本。Gen 用 SFT 训练，Stream 则使用派生的 token 标签与监督分类损失。报告还展示了在 GSPO 安全 RL 实验中用 Gen 充当安全评审器。这一后续奖励演示与过滤/RL 设计相关，但并不是护栏模型自身的已验证训练合约。

title: Method
方法
html:
For Gen, the report says the more-than-1.19M mixture contains human-annotated and synthetic prompt/response samples. It uses Self-Instruct: the safety policy is decomposed into a fine-grained taxonomy; seed prompts, category-specific keywords, and paired safe/unsafe prompts drive synthesis. Responses include human-authored and model-generated material. The report names Qwen2.5-72B-Base as an example generator for unsafe responses and names QwQ, Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, and DeepSeek distills as sources of reasoning-content responses. It translates original content to 15 additional languages with Qwen-MT and describes language-mixing detection, an LLM judge, and random manual review. Source records, seed sets, prompts, sampling settings, item-level provenance, rights, and retention yields are not published.

For automatic annotation, the report uses multiple Qwen versions, including Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct and Qwen3-235B-A22B, and aggregates preliminary labels by voting. It splits data into disjoint A/B partitions, trains strict/loose models with reweighted safe/unsafe samples, and marks cross-partition prediction conflicts as controversial. It then uses Qwen3-32B for a further disjoint-partition label-distillation pass. Gen is vanilla SFT on instruction-tuned Qwen3. Its released output interface includes risk/category and, for response classification, refusal; the exact training record schema and labeler prompts are unknown.

For Stream, the report derives a boundary token for unsafe or controversial responses. For each prefix it samples rollout continuations from a diverse model ensemble and scores completed responses with Gen; an LLM judge, Qwen3-235B-A22B, reviews flagged prefixes without predicting future text. A boundary is accepted only if both signals call the prefix unsafe, after which the boundary and later tokens retain the sample-level label. Stream jointly trains query and response heads with cross-entropy: query loss is at the end-of-query token, response risk/category losses are token-wise, and category loss is conditional on unsafe/controversial ground truth. The rollout composition/count, threshold, judge prompt, calibration, optimizer details, and released token-label data are unknown.

The report separately demonstrates Gen as a reward signal for GSPO safety RL of Qwen3-4B. It creates eight answers per WildJailbreak training prompt in thinking and non-thinking modes, removes groups that are all safe or all unsafe, and retains 13.7k/6.7k samples. This is a downstream application construction rule; it must not be read back into the guard's own 1.19M corpus or SFT contract.

对于 Gen，报告称超过 119 万条的混合数据由人工标注和合成的提示/回复样本组成。它使用 Self-Instruct：将安全策略拆分为细粒度 taxonomy，并用种子提示、类别特定关键词和成对的安全/不安全提示驱动合成。回复包括人工撰写和模型生成材料。报告将 Qwen2.5-72B-Base 列为生成不安全回复的示例生成器，并把 QwQ、Qwen3、DeepSeek-R1 和 DeepSeek 蒸馏模型列为带推理内容回复的来源。它用 Qwen-MT 将原始内容翻译为另外 15 种语言，并说明采用语言混杂检测、LLM 评审和随机人工抽查。源记录、种子集合、提示词、采样设置、记录级来源、权利和保留率均未发布。

对于自动标注，报告使用多个 Qwen 版本（包括 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-235B-A22B），并通过投票聚合初始标签。它把数据划分为互不相交的 A/B 两部分，用重加权的安全/不安全样本训练 strict/loose 模型，并将跨分区预测冲突项标为 controversial。随后又使用 Qwen3-32B 进行另一轮互不相交分区的标签蒸馏。Gen 在指令微调后的 Qwen3 上进行 vanilla SFT。其已发布输出接口包含风险/类别，并在回复分类时包含拒答；精确的训练记录 schema 和标注器提示词未知。

对于 Stream，报告为不安全或 controversial 回复派生边界 token。它为每个前缀从多样化模型集成中采样 rollout 延续，并用 Gen 对完整回复评分；LLM 评审器 Qwen3-235B-A22B 在不预测后续文本的条件下复核被标记前缀。只有两个信号都判定前缀不安全时才接受边界，此后边界及后续 token 保留样本级标签。Stream 用交叉熵联合训练 query 和 response 分类头：query 损失在 end-of-query token 计算，response 风险/类别损失逐 token 计算，类别损失只在不安全/controversial 真值上计算。rollout 组成/数量、阈值、评审提示词、校准、优化器细节和已发布的 token 标签数据未知。

报告还独立展示了将 Gen 作为 Qwen3-4B 的 GSPO 安全 RL 奖励信号：对每个 WildJailbreak 训练提示在 thinking 与 non-thinking 模式下生成 8 个答案，删除全部安全或全部不安全的组，并保留 13.7k/6.7k 样本。这是下游应用构造规则，不能倒推为护栏自身 119 万条语料或 SFT 合约的一部分。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The technical report evaluates Gen and Stream across English, Chinese, and multilingual prompt/response benchmarks. It reports F1 tables for strict and loose handling of controversial cases, and it releases Qwen3GuardTest as an evaluation artifact. The report also evaluates streaming detection latency and reports an exact-hit measure near 86.0% for direct responses; with thinking content, it reports detection within the first 128 tokens in about 66.8% of cases. These are reported evaluations, not a substitute for an independently reproducible data or calibration audit.

For the separate safety-RL application, the reported hybrid reward raises the WildGuard-evaluated safety rate from about 60 to above 97 while aiming to control over-refusal. The authors explicitly avoid Qwen3Guard as that experiment's safety evaluator and use Qwen3-235B-Instruct-2507 plus WildGuard instead. This supports a bounded claim that the report tested guard-based rewards; it does not establish universal reward calibration, dataset-filter reliability, or transfer to other policies and deployments.

Official Qwen sources provide a release repository, an official model collection, checkpoint model cards, and a report-linked public evaluation dataset. They do not provide the 1.19M training records, the complete policy/label specification history, or end-to-end construction and training code.

技术报告在英文、中文和多语种的提示/回复基准上评估 Gen 与 Stream。它报告了对 controversial 样本采用 strict/loose 处理的 F1 表，并发布 Qwen3GuardTest 作为评测工件。报告还评估流式检测延迟：对直接回复报告了接近 86.0% 的 exact-hit 指标；带 thinking 内容时，约 66.8% 的样本能在前 128 个 token 内检测到。这些是报告中的评测，并不能替代独立可复现的数据或校准审计。

对于独立的安全 RL 应用，报告称 hybrid reward 在控制过度拒答的同时，将 WildGuard 评估的安全率从约 60 提升到 97 以上。作者明确没有用 Qwen3Guard 作为该实验的安全评估器，而是使用 Qwen3-235B-Instruct-2507 和 WildGuard。这支持一个受限结论：报告测试了基于护栏的奖励；它并不能证明奖励的通用校准、数据过滤可靠性或向其他策略与部署的迁移性。

Qwen 官方来源提供了发布仓库、官方模型集合、检查点模型卡和报告链接的公开评测数据集。它们没有提供 119 万条训练记录、完整的策略/标签规范历史或端到端构造与训练代码。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The report combines a three-level safety policy with two different moderation interfaces: instruction-following whole-item assessment in Gen and token-wise monitoring in Stream. Its most relevant construction disclosure is not merely the released weights: it describes paired policy-conditioned prompt synthesis, cross-partition controversial-label construction, label distillation, and a dual-signal procedure for converting coarse response labels into Stream boundary labels.

Within this atlas, the novelty is therefore a partially visible safety-data and feedback pipeline. It is not an open, provenance-complete safety dataset or a fully specified, policy-independent verifier. The report's separate guard-as-reward experiment is a useful application disclosure, not proof that every filtering or RL use of the released guard follows the reported contract.

报告将三级安全策略与两种不同审核接口结合：Gen 进行指令遵循的整项判断，Stream 进行逐 token 监测。其最相关的构造披露不只是发布了权重：还描述了策略条件下的成对提示合成、跨分区 controversial 标签构造、标签蒸馏，以及把粗粒度回复标签转换为 Stream 边界标签的双信号过程。

因此，在本图谱中，它的新意是一个部分可见的安全数据与反馈流水线，而不是一个来源完整公开的安全数据集或完全指定、策略无关的验证器。报告中独立的“护栏作为奖励”实验是有用的应用披露，但不能证明发布护栏的每一种过滤或 RL 用法都遵循该报告合约。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The report itself warns that adversarial prompt engineering may bypass guardrails; safety annotations may encode cultural or demographic bias; and Stream's partial-context architecture can produce more false positives or false negatives, particularly out of distribution or in low-resource languages. It also notes that the model is not geolocation- or policy-adaptive.

The disclosure ledger adds separate reproducibility limits. The 1.19M corpus has no released records, source manifest, rights mapping, seed set, complete prompts, labeler settings, or item-level lineage. The reported auto-label F1 is not a released calibration or error audit. Stream's rollout ensemble, count, threshold, judge prompt, and token-label data are incomplete. The public Qwen3GuardTest dataset is an evaluation artifact, not the training corpus. Finally, the reported GSPO filter/reward setup applies to a downstream Qwen3-4B experiment and must not be generalized into the guard's own training recipe or a validated universal safety filter.

报告自身警告，对抗性提示工程可能绕过护栏；安全标注可能编码文化或人口群体偏差；Stream 的部分上下文架构可能产生更多误报或漏报，尤其在分布外或低资源语言情形下。报告还说明模型并不具备地理位置或策略自适应能力。

披露账本还记录了独立的可复现性限制。119 万条语料没有发布记录、来源清单、权利映射、种子集、完整提示词、标注器设置或记录级谱系。报告中的自动标注 F1 不是已发布的校准或错误审计。Stream 的 rollout 集成、数量、阈值、评审提示词和 token 标签数据并不完整。公开的 Qwen3GuardTest 是评测工件，而不是训练语料。最后，报告中的 GSPO 过滤/奖励设置适用于下游 Qwen3-4B 实验，不能泛化为护栏自身训练配方或已经验证的通用安全过滤器。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Track 12, this Card is useful because it makes a sharp distinction among three layers that are often collapsed: (1) a released moderation checkpoint and inference interface, (2) a partly disclosed supervised construction pipeline for that checkpoint, and (3) a demonstrated downstream use of the checkpoint for safety RL, filtering, or streaming intervention.

Researchers can use the report to study policy-conditioned labels, controversial-case treatment, token-boundary labeling, or guard-based feedback design. Reusers should treat the 1.19M mixture as an undocumented data object rather than a downloadable dataset, and should validate policy fit, calibration, adversarial behavior, language fairness, tokenization compatibility, and downstream reward/filter effects in their own environment.

对 Track 12 而言，这张卡片的价值在于清楚区分三个常被混为一谈的层次：(1) 已发布的审核检查点和推理接口；(2) 该检查点部分披露的监督构造流水线；以及 (3) 该检查点在安全 RL、过滤或流式干预中的一个已演示下游用法。

研究者可借助报告研究策略条件化标签、controversial 样本处理、token 边界标注或基于护栏的反馈设计。复用者应把 119 万条混合数据视为未公开的数据对象，而不是可下载数据集，并在自身环境中验证策略匹配、校准、对抗行为、语言公平性、分词兼容性以及下游奖励/过滤效果。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3.2–3.3 before treating “1.19M labeled samples” as a reusable dataset: it is a composition-level disclosure, not a record release.
  • Separate Gen's verified SFT and Stream's supervised token-label contract from the later GSPO safety-RL demonstration.
  • For Stream, inspect the rollout-plus-judge boundary construction and list its undisclosed ensemble, threshold, prompt, calibration, and token-label details.
  • Use Qwen3GuardTest only as the reported public evaluation artifact; it does not establish the training mixture's provenance or split audit.

• 在把“119 万条已标注样本”视为可复用数据集之前，先读 §3.2–3.3：这只是组成层面的披露，不是记录发布。
  • 将 Gen 已验证的 SFT 和 Stream 的监督 token 标签合约，与后续 GSPO 安全 RL 演示明确分开。
  • 对 Stream，应检查“rollout 加评审器”的边界构造，并列出未披露的集成、阈值、提示词、校准和 token 标签细节。
  • Qwen3GuardTest 只能作为报告中的公开评测工件；它不能证明训练混合数据的来源或划分审计。

value_zh.html: LLMs 生成 Self-Instruct 提示与初步标签；Qwen2.5-72B-Base 是不安全响应生成器的示例。对于单独的安全 RL 演示，Qwen3-4B 为每个 WildJailbreak 提示生成八条响应。完整生成器分配与设置未知。

value.html: The report describes policy-guided generation, paired examples, multilingual translation, data reweighting, voting, and disjoint-partition refinement. Sampling temperatures, seeds, per-source rates, draw counts, and core-training retention yields are unknown.

value_zh.html: 报告描述策略引导生成、成对示例、多语言翻译、数据重加权、投票与不相交划分精炼。采样温度、seeds、逐来源比率、抽取计数与核心训练保留产出未知。

value.html: No full core-guard training retention rule is released. The separate safety-RL demonstration removes prompt groups whose eight Qwen3-4B outputs are all uniformly safe or uniformly unsafe; it yields 13.7k thinking and 6.7k non-thinking samples. This reported application filter is not assumed for the 1.19M guard-training corpus.

value_zh.html: 未发布完整核心 guard 训练保留规则。单独的安全 RL 演示移除其八条 Qwen3-4B 输出全部均匀安全或全部均匀不安全的提示组；产生 13.7k 思考与 6.7k 非思考样本。此所报告应用过滤器不假定用于 1.19M guard 训练语料。

value.html: Stream uses per-token classification and a debouncing rule in evaluation; the report does not disclose complete training/inference compute budgets, rollouts per prefix, or latency hardware configuration.

value_zh.html: Stream 在评测中使用逐 token 分类与去抖动规则；报告未披露完整训练/推理计算预算、每前缀 rollouts 或延迟硬件配置。

value.html: Gen uses vanilla SFT; Stream jointly trains query/response heads with cross-entropy and conditional category loss. A distinct application experiment trains Qwen3-4B with GSPO using Qwen3Guard reward signals. Optimizer hyperparameters, schedules, batches, weights, and the full release training scaffold are unknown.

value_zh.html: Gen 使用 vanilla SFT；Stream 用交叉熵与条件类别损失联合训练查询/响应头。一项独立应用实验用 GSPO 与 Qwen3Guard 奖励信号训练 Qwen3-4B。优化器超参数、日程、batches、权重与完整发布训练脚手架未知。

value.html: The report discloses more than 1.19M human-annotated and synthetic prompt/response samples and aggregate language proportions, plus construction roles. It does not release a source manifest, seed sets, item counts by source/category, full safety-policy versions, label records, prompts, source rights, or immutable dataset revisions. Qwen3GuardTest is a released evaluation dataset, not the training corpus.

value_zh.html: 报告披露超过 1.19M 人工标注与合成提示/响应样本及聚合语言比例，外加构建角色。它未发布来源清单、种子集、按来源/类别的条目计数、完整安全策略版本、标签记录、提示、来源权利或不可变数据集修订。Qwen3GuardTest 是已发布评测数据集，不是训练语料。

value.html: Disjoint A/B partitions are used for controversial-label building and distillation. Public benchmark/test datasets and one released Qwen3GuardTest evaluation dataset are named, but train/validation/test memberships, construction, overlap controls, and immutable split manifests are incomplete.

value_zh.html: 不相交 A/B 划分用于有争议标签构建与蒸馏。点名了公开基准/测试数据集与一份已发布 Qwen3GuardTest 评测数据集，但 train/validation/test 成员资格、构建、重叠控制与不可变划分清单不完整。

items: The report says adversarial paraphrasing, obfuscation, or context manipulation may bypass the guard.
Safety labels can reflect source-dataset cultural assumptions and produce unfair multilingual or demographic moderation outcomes.
Partial-context Stream classification can have higher false positives or false negatives, especially out of distribution or in low-resource languages.
Safety-policy versions, record provenance, labeler prompts/votes, calibration, error audit, retention, and rights are not sufficient for independent reconstruction.
The separately demonstrated safety-RL filter/reward setup should not be conflated with the guard's own SFT/token-label training contract.
报告称对抗性改写、混淆或上下文操纵可能绕过 guard。
安全标签可反映来源数据集的文化假设，并产生不公平的多语言或人口统计审核结果。
部分上下文 Stream 分类可有更高假阳性或假阴性，尤其在分布外或低资源语言中。
安全策略版本、记录出处、标注者提示/投票、校准、误差审计、保留与权利不足以独立重建。
单独演示的安全 RL 过滤/奖励设置不应与 guard 自身的 SFT/token-label 训练契约混为一谈。

value.html: Official sources establish Qwen3 base/instruction-tuned models to Gen SFT and Stream heads, with Qwen-model label/refinement roles and separate downstream GSPO/CARE demonstrations. Sample-to-generator-to-label-to-checkpoint mappings and revision pins are unavailable.
